otterMail.name: Otter Drive
otterMail.description: Saves attachments and emails to Otter Drive, and browses your artifacts.
otterMail.dataUse: Sends Otter Drive only what you choose to save: the attachment or the email, with the title you give it. Everyone in the Otter Drive organization can see it. Your Otter Drive sign-in stays on this device.
